name: Eole Chat - Qwen3.8-27B INT4
readme: Eole browser Chat with RedHat Qwen3.8-27B INT4. Before deploying, create a private RunPod Secret named eole_password with at least 16 characters. Choose one x86-hosted NVIDIA GPU with at least 32 GB VRAM and a driver supporting CUDA 13.2; RTX 5090 is locally tested. Open Connect > HTTP port 5000 and sign in as eole with your secret. Preparation automatically builds GPU kernels, downloads/converts the model, and starts Eole. The first request compiles inference. The volume stores weights and kernel caches. Account, storage/GPU payment confirmation and initial preparation are required. Only Chat is provisioned. H100/H200 are expected compatible but not hardware-validated; Grace ARM systems are not supported by this image. No SSH service is installed. See https://github.com/eole-nlp/eole/tree/main/recipes/runpod for details.
